-- INCIDENT #1842: Payment Integrity Investigation
-- Task: Identify orders marked as 'paid' that lack a corresponding transaction.
-- Tables available: orders, payments, transactions, refunds

SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.status AS order_status
FROM orders o
LIMIT 10;

-- Goal: Calculate total abandoned cart values and filter for carts worth > $100.
-- Tables: carts (id, user_id, status), cart_items (id, cart_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price)

    c.id AS cart_id,
    c.user_id,
    c.status
FROM carts c
